name: Adit
author: E. T. Carter
description: An off-axis glance down a timbered mine gallery: the black vanishing depth pinned in the lower-right third while sheared trapezoidal support frames - two posts and a cap beam - recede forever into it in an exponential scale series, each hung with one warm lamp. A pair of glowing rails crossed by dim sleepers converges on the same depth. Frames, rails and lamps all shrink away down the scale axis, the log-periodic wrap hidden under the edge fade at birth and the fog at death.

params.label: Descent speed
params.effect: Scale-octaves per second the timber frames recede into the gallery.

params.label: Frame density
params.effect: Timber frames per scale octave; higher reads as closely-set supports.

params.label: Timber width
params.effect: Stroke width of the posts and cap beams, in CSS pixels.

params.label: Lamp glow
params.effect: Brightness of the hanging lamp under each cap beam.

params.label: Vanishing point X
params.effect: Horizontal placement of the bore's vanishing depth — left, centred, or (default) pinned to the off-axis right third for the raking glance.

params.label: Vanishing point Y
params.effect: Vertical placement of the vanishing depth — high, centred, or (default) dropped into the lower third for the down-the-drift view.

params.label: Rake
params.effect: How hard the timber verticals shear with height — 0 a square head-on portal, high a steep oblique rake down the gallery.

params.label: Rail glow
params.effect: Brightness of the glowing floor rails and their bloom converging on the depth — from dim ghost rails to a bright lit track.

params.label: Cribbing
params.effect: Strength of the diagonal cribbing braces inside each frame — 0 clean portals, up a dense braced timber warren (alternating diagonal per frame).

params.label: Roll
params.effect: Static bank rotation of the whole gallery about the vanishing point, in degrees — tilt the drift off the horizontal.

params.label: Roll drift
params.effect: Continuous slow roll about the vanishing point, radians per second — a gentle banking spin layered over the descent (0 holds still).

params.label: Mouse parallax
params.effect: How far the vanishing point glides toward the pointer for a smooth look-around parallax (0 locks it; no effect on the static poster).
